answer: The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in terrace, expire in crystal, and meadow lists each expiry. Someone running 76 aliases hence needs 95 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3673 identities would post 4665 proofs and burn roughly 2 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
